functions.name: EscapeString
functions.summary: EscapeString escapes special characters like "<" to become "<". It escapes only five such characters: <, >, &, ' and ". [UnescapeString](EscapeString(s)) == s always holds, but the converse isn't always true.

functions.name: UnescapeString
functions.summary: UnescapeString unescapes entities like "<" to become "<". It unescapes a larger range of entities than [EscapeString] escapes. For example, "á" unescapes to "á", as does "á" and "á". UnescapeString([EscapeString](s)) == s always holds, but the converse isn't always true.
